description: Guard for the Glowming campaign files: guard.js checks every write, shell command and connector call against an allow-list using the files on disk; calendar-links.js puts the posting calendar back if a save lost a tracking link; a content-only check reads the text being written.

hooks.prompt:
Judge only the TEXT this tool call would write: $TOOL_INPUT

BLOCK if the new text contains any of: a password, API key, token, card or bank number, or ID number; a cost price, landed cost, margin or internal funding split; another company's or client's private business that is not Glowming; a computer file path such as C:/Users/...; ANY weight-loss, fat-burning, detox, appetite or craving claim, cure, or medical claim (never allowed, with or without a source); any other NEW health or benefit claim (what the product does for energy, gut, skin, digestion, immunity or similar) that is not copied word for word from approved advert wording and has no written source named next to it. Shell commands and connector calls are handled by a separate guard; judge only this text. ALLOW everything else. If you block, say in one plain sentence what to remove or what source is needed.
